family.description: This entry represents a member of a biosynthetic gene cluster (BGC). This BGC (BGC0001577) is described by MIBiG as an example of the following biosynthetic class, RiPP (ribosomally synthesised and post-translationally modified peptide). It includes lantibiotic duramycin, duramycin B and cinnamycin. Duramycin B is a potent inhibitor of human phospholipase A2 [[cite:PUB00151902]].
family.name: Lantibiotic duramycin B-like
